scope: A fictional settings page with inconsistent spacing and controls
user_task: Understand preferences and save a valid selection without losing context

design_decision.why: Controls and section labels need clear relationships before decoration
design_decision.rejected_alternative: Large decorative hero and duplicated explanatory cards would obscure settings
design_decision.primary_focus: Current setting and its actionable control
design_decision.signature_element: No special signature element: operational clarity is the priority

review.source: Synthetic teaching scenario, not a real product screenshot

issues.root_cause_hypothesis: Section-level gap collapsed into item padding
issues.recommended_fix: Restore layout-owned section gap and keep per-row padding
issues.validation: Open the actual page at target viewport and check rendered gap in both directions

notes: All decisions and issues are synthetic. A passing validator does not prove aesthetic quality or a real UI fix.
